newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Two questioned in probe of ABB extortion charges.
newsitem.headline: Two questioned in probe of ABB extortion charges.

text.p: A Swiss prosecutor said on Monday he had questioned two people last week in an extortion probe requested last month by Swiss-Swedish engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG.
"I can confirm that we questioned two people last week in connection with our investigation into attempted extortion," Zurich prosecutor Urs Hubmann told Reuters.

Hubmann said the investigation was based on a complaint ABB lodged late last month alleging extortion in connection with a contract with carmaker Volkswagen AG (VW) to build a paint plant at VW's Czech Skoda unit.
VW started its own probe after media reports alleged VW employees had demanded and received bribes relating to the contract, which was awarded to ABB.
Hubmann declined to confirm or deny weekend news reports that identified one suspect in the Zurich case as a German businessman.
